architecture.title: The red-team harness — one suite, every combination of controls, two numbers
architecture.caption: The suite (week28_maestro_mas_security/common/redteam.py) holds 12 attack and 8 benign scenarios, each tagged with MAESTRO layers and OWASP ASI ids (the course's mapping). Each scenario runs on a fresh simulated hotel with a chosen Defenses set and a brain: SIM (deterministic teaching model) or LIVE (local Ollama, gemma4:12b, a shared budget of 6 calls). The world reports harms; benign scenarios report whether the job got done. The scorecard turns that into attack success rate and utility; the matrix, cost and minimal-set labs reuse the same runs.

sequence.title: Exhaustive search: one combination, with early exit
sequence.caption: Lab 09-3 tries each of the 8192 combinations by running the hardest attacks first (A04, A09, A12 have a single blocker) and stopping at the first failure. Captured on this Mac: 26,944 scenario runs instead of 163,840, 8.7 s in total, 672 passing combinations, the smallest of size 5.
